GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.93 (27 Dec 45) GC-P
(SCAPIN - 504)
27 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Operation of Government Meteorological Stations Located on the Detached Islands.
1. Reference C. L. O. Number 808 (3.2), 1 December 1945, final action will be delayed.
2. Specific stations that will be required to remain operative will be determined after receipt of report from officer inspecting the weather facilities on the detached islands.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
